index.title: IntegratED - Empowering Learner Education
index.hero_subtext: Launching at ACS Athens with a mission to build bridges through education and cultural exchange with The Home Project.
index.launch_p1: IntegratED is launching at ACS Athens in Greece, creating a comprehensive learning ecosystem that combines cutting-edge technology with proven pedagogical methods. Made possible by generous support and in collaboration with The Home Project, we’re building the foundation for refugee education integration.
index.launch_p2: Our AI-powered adaptive learning platform personalises education for each learner, while our peer-matching system connects local volunteers and learners who share common interests, fostering genuine friendships and cultural exchange.
index.launch_p3: Starting with ACS Athens, we’re not just teaching subjects – we’re building confidence, fostering integration, and opening doors to brighter futures.
index.commitment_text: IntegratED provides essential educational opportunities in Language and Digital Literacy to refugees and underserved populations. We believe in the power of education to unlock potential and build bridges.
index.no_articles: Latest updates and program news will appear here soon.
index.meta_description: IntegratED is a youth-to-youth learning programme in Athens: student volunteers and young refugees learning side by side, with an app built around pictures and sound.
index.hero_lead: IntegratED is a youth-to-youth learning programme in Athens. Student volunteers from ACS Athens meet young refugees supported by The Home Project, and they learn side by side with an app made for people who are just starting to read.
index.hero_learner_link: Sign up with your invite code
index.photo_1_alt: Two teenagers reading and using a tablet together
index.photo_2_alt: A girl helping a boy with his homework
index.photo_3_alt: Two teenagers looking at a tablet together
index.mission_statement: We believe learning together builds bridges between languages, cultures and young people.
index.mission_detail: Many of the young people we work with had their schooling interrupted, and some are learning to read for the first time. IntegratED helps them find their way back into learning, with someone their own age by their side.
index.who_heading: The people at the heart of IntegratED.
index.who_learners_tag: Young refugees supported by The Home Project
index.who_learners_text: Many had their schooling interrupted, and some are reading for the first time in any language. Here they can start with pictures and sound, at their own pace.
index.who_volunteers_text: They give their time to meet a learner, practise together and be a friendly face along the way.
index.who_teachers_tag: The people who run the programme
index.who_teachers_text: They pair learners with volunteers, keep track of every session and hand out worksheets.
index.session_lead: Two young people, one lesson and plenty of encouragement.
index.session_1_text: A volunteer and their learner meet up for their session.
index.session_2_text: They open the learner's next lesson together: a quiz or one of five games.
index.session_3_text: Tap the speaker, repeat the words, and try again when something is tricky.
index.session_4_text: Both log the session. The learner earns XP, levels up and unlocks new looks for their character.
index.demo_title: See a lesson through a learner's eyes.
index.demo_intro: Many of our learners are just starting to read, so every question comes with a picture and a speaker button. Here are three real questions from our English course. Wrong answers are fine: just try again.
index.demo_idle: Tap the answer you think is right.
index.demo_done_text: You got {correct} of {total} right on the first try and earned {xp} XP. That's how every lesson feels for our learners.
index.feature_audio_text: A speaker button reads questions and words out loud.
index.feature_languages_text: Menus and help appear in the learner's own language, including right-to-left scripts.
index.feature_abc_text: The English course begins with the alphabet and builds up to full sentences.
index.feature_retry_text: A wrong answer turns red and the learner simply picks again. Nobody has to start over.
index.games_lead: Many lessons are played as games, so practice doesn't feel like a test. Every right answer moves the game forward.
index.game_rocket_text: Answer quick questions to fuel your rocket and blast off.
index.game_storm_text: Pick out the right words before the storm blows them away.
index.game_match_text: Find the pairs, like a capital letter and its small letter.
index.game_garden_text: Right answers water your garden. Plant seeds and watch them bloom.
index.game_potion_text: Choose a recipe, pick the right ingredients and brew a potion.
index.involve_heading: There's a place for you here.
index.involve_lead: IntegratED runs on young people who show up for each other. Here's how you can be part of it.
index.involve_volunteer_text: Students at ACS Athens sign up with their school's invite code and get paired with a learner.
index.involve_support_text: Donations help the programme grow and reach more young people.
index.involve_learn_text: Young people at The Home Project join with an invite code from their teacher.
index.photo_session_alt: Two young people laughing together while working on a tablet
index.design_lead: Every part of IntegratED assumes a learner might not read yet, and might not speak English yet either.
index.door_student_title: I'm a student at ACS Athens
index.door_student_text: Sign up with your school's invite code and get paired with a learner.
index.door_school_text: Bring IntegratED to your students. Rosters, matching and attendance are built in.
index.door_support_text: Donations help the programme reach more young people.
index.game_lantern_text: Tap the lantern with the right answer and light a star in the night sky.
